pattern_id: Double commit via equivocating blocks - is_committed checks Digest allowing same slot to commit twice
description: Linearizer can double-commit equivocating blocks at the same (Round, Author) slot because is_committed() checks include Digest, treating two equivocating blocks as different
trigger_condition: Byzantine validator creates equivocating blocks (same slot, different content). Block A committed first, then Block B committed through different DAG path because is_committed(BlockRef) returns false for B (different digest)
root_cause: Commit status check uses BlockRef (including Digest) instead of Slot (Round, Author). Two equivocating blocks have different digests, so they are treated as uncommitted independently.
fix_approach: Add is_any_block_at_slot_committed(Slot) method to check if ANY block at a given (Round, Author) slot has been committed, regardless of digest
